basic_profile.bio: A history enthusiast based in Tulsa, Oklahoma, who's been a Redditor for over seven years. Fascinated by alternative history scenarios, especially those dealing with geographical and political changes. Works as a high school history teacher and spends weekends gaming and exploring new manga series. Typically online during evenings after class and weekends. Enjoys engaging in thoughtful discussions and has a knack for strategic games. Married, with a keen interest in online communities that blend education with entertainment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor's degree in History and has been teaching high school history for over a decade. Self-taught in various strategic games, and follows developments in the gaming community closely. Regularly reads historical fiction and alternative history literature, enhancing their ability to contribute meaningfully to discussions on such topics.
